violations.text: The presence of rodents and flying insects is not controlled as evidenced by a large accumulation of droppings and live activity of flying insects. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
Coffee beans were observed stored on the floor . Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The scoops in the dry ingredients were observed with the handles touching the dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the bleach sanitizing solution for the 3-bay. Current test strips expired last year. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving and pallets have an accumulation of rodent droppings. All areas to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of rodent droppings. The floors and walls in the back prep area have an accumulation of food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The coving in the bathroom area is in poor repair. A large gap was observed with rodent droppings due to missing coving. Area to be cleaned and the physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026
A small amount of droppings were observed in the grout in the corner of the storage area. Area to be cleaned and monitored. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2025
